mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, job_task_id, generation_id, batch_key FROM batch.process_staging_generation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND generation_status IN ('OPEN', 'SEALED') AND job_task_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours}) ORDER BY created_at, generation_id LIMIT #{batchSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM batch.process_staging_generation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND generation_status IN ('OPEN', 'SEALED') AND job_task_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours})

SELECT tenant_id, job_task_id, generation_id, batch_key FROM batch.process_staging_generation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND generation_status IN ('OPEN', 'SEALED') AND job_task_id IS NOT NULL AND generation_id > COALESCE(CAST(#{generationId} AS uuid), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) ORDER BY generation_id LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: DO $partition$ BEGIN EXECUTE format( 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch.%I PARTITION OF batch.process_staging ' || 'FOR VALUES FROM (%L) TO (%L)', '${partitionName}', '${fromTs}', '${toTs}'); EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE batch.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', '${partitionName}'); EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE batch.%I FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', '${partitionName}'); EXECUTE format( 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_transition ON batch.%I', '${partitionName}'); EXECUTE format( 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_strict ON batch.%I', '${partitionName}'); EXECUTE format( 'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_strict ON batch.%I AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC ' || 'USING (tenant_id = current_setting(''app.tenant_id'', true) ' || 'AND staging_generation_id::text = current_setting(''app.process_staging_generation_id'', true)) ' || 'WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting(''app.tenant_id'', true) ' || 'AND staging_generation_id::text = current_setting(''app.process_staging_generation_id'', true))', '${partitionName}'); END $partition$
